name: What steps are involved in the bathroom vanity upgrade process with your company?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the bathroom vanity upgrade process with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our bathroom vanity upgrade process typically begins with an initial consultation and site visit to discuss your vision, take measurements, and assess existing conditions. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, materials, and timeline. Once approved, we assist with material selection, schedule the project, and proceed with removal of the old vanity and professional installation of the new one, including any necessary plumbing or electrical work. The final step involves a thorough clean-up and walk-through to ensure your complete satisfaction, providing full process clarity from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, proposal, material selection, installation (including plumbing/electrical), and a final walk-through, ensuring a clear process from start to finish.
